messages:
Lina: Quick follow-up from todays all-hands Q&A around Redwood Optimize, eval gating, and model-fallback behavior. Dropping this thread so folks can pick owners and links. Recording + slides: https://redwood.ai/allhands/may-2026 :sparkles:
Marco: Thanks! Two asks from customers: (1) can Optimize suggest quantization profiles per-model-per-workload? (2) how do we signal expected quality regressions post-quant?
Tess: For (1) yes  Optimize will surface recommended profiles. We need a small UI tweak to show "expected throughput uplift" + "expected quality delta". Owner for UI change: @Tess. ETA: 2 weeks.
Omar: For (2) we should tie quant recommendations to eval suites. If a profile shows >2% regression on a critical eval, we warn and recommend fallback. Who owns eval mapping? @Priya?
Priya: I can own the eval-to-profile mapping. Will produce a mapping CSV and add to the docs. ETA: next Wed.
Marco: Can we have automatic rollbacks when quality metrics drop during rollout? Customers want automated safety nets.
Tess: We already have a rollout hook for metrics. Need to add a "quality sentinel" metric that watches eval-set drift during canary. Owner: @Tess + @Priya.
Lina: Action: Define sentinel metric, threshold, and automated rollback policy. Keep it conservative at first.
analytics-bot: Note: last weeks eval baseline run finished. Baseline IDs: base-2026-05-01. See https://metrics.redwood.ai/runs/base-2026-05-01
Omar: Ops question: model-fallback sequence when a variant is offline. Current plan in talk was: try same-family quant variant -> fall back to lower-cost region -> fall back to hosted on failover. Need to formalize in docs.
Priya: I'll write the fallback decision tree and include latency/cost estimates for each leg. First draft by Fri.
Marco: Sales needs a short blurb for customers about "what to expect during optimization": e.g., brief downtime? none, possible perf variance, how we notify. Can marketing please convert owner list into one-liner?
Lina: Marketing: please use the one-pager from Priya + Tess. Ben will sign off on phrasing with legal.
Tess: Quick tech note for eng runtime: add a metric "fallback_count" with labels (customer, route, reason). Helps correlate with eval regressions. Owner: @Omar.
Omar: Adding to instrumentation backlog. Will include Grafana panel and alert.
Lina: Compact action list:
- @Tess: UI tweak for recommendation UX + sentinel integration (2w)
- @Priya: eval-to-profile mapping CSV + docs (next Wed)
- @Omar: fallback metric, Grafana panel, alerts (start next sprint)
- @Marco: one-liner for sales (uses Priya/Tess draft)
- @Analytics-bot: surface baseline links in the Optimize dashboard (infra request)
Please @mention here if you pick up or reassign. Ill ping next Tue with progress. :rocket:
